A '''refueling station''' [[orbit]]ed the [[planet]] [[Rakata Prime]]<ref name="TUC" /> in the [[Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Appendix" /> The adventurous chef [[Strono Tuggs|Strono "Cookie" Tuggs]] once visited the [[Space station|station]], where he consumed a cup of a strong [[caf]] known as [[Hyperspace Brew]] while the resident clerk told him about the [[Rakatan]] [[species]] that used to inhabit Rakata Prime. Tuggs later mentioned his experience at the [[Fuel|refueling]] station in a recipe for the local drink published in ''[[The Ultimate Cookbook]]''<ref name="TUC" /> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="TUC date">{{UltimateCookbookDate}}</ref>

{{Station-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The refueling station above Rakata Prime was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Cookbook]]'', a [[2023]] cookbook of ''[[Star Wars]]''–inspired recipes written by [[Jenn Fujikawa]] and [[Marc Sumerak]].<ref name="TUC" />
